in_sanskrit.name: SurbhiJyoti
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Wealthy Goddess, Gold and Jasmine
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: SurbhiJyoti एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Surbhi means wealth and Jyoti means Goddess or Light. This name signifies the goddess of prosperity and is derived from the Sanskrit words Surbhi (wealth) and Jyoti (goddess or light). This name is also associated with jasmine flowers which signify beauty and wealth.
